issues.title: Players refer to standard areas
issues.body:
As a player I wish to **Select a polygon from an existing list** in order to **refer to standard areas**

As players are doing high level planning of the next turn, they start referring to standard areas.

Some areas may be on land, and some on sea.  The whole current map may be split into, say 10 polygons.

While generating their orders, players may wish to select an existing polygon instead of drawing one.

So, we will introduce a `areas` array in the `WargameData` object.  Like the other elements in the `WargameData` object this will have a parent `wrapper` element called `areas` that contains an array of `ArrayData` elements.  These array elements will have these parameters:
```
  // user label for this shape
  name: string
  // which forces use this shape
  usedBy: Array<ForceData['uniqid']>
  // the shape itself (probably a Polygon, but could be line or point)
  feature: GeoJSON.Polygon
``` 

This will be supported in the `OrderDrawing` and `OrderEditing` pages.

The will receive a new prop called `areas: AreaData[]`.  This will have already been filtered by the parent class for this force.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/217224141-dff9db1d-9ba8-4df9-aba1-56d751a4a6e6.png)

If the next shape to be drawn is a polygon, then a new drop-down list will appear next to the `Cancel editing` button.  This will contain a list of areas for this force. Selecting one will add that polygon to the set of shapes, and move onto the next one.

Hi @IanMayo, I have some questions:
- In OrderDrawing generate planning activity using selected polygon: do you mean we generate a planning activity on planning polygon (not a "completed" polygon)?
- Aaah, err, in the current implementation we get a new control each time we create new orders. I'm sure it should be deleted: Can you explain more detail?

1.  Currently - when the player finishes the polygon, the `useState` handler for `pendingGeometry` looks at the new shape, and creates a new `res` item, and adds it to the list.  But, if a player clicks one of these existing areas, we should make that `useState` handler create the new geometry from the existing one (provided in the useStandardArea click-handler)
2. If we cancel drawing the polygon, the standard-area-menu is still shown. We should remove it on `Cancel` or after a standard area is selected. Video below.
